unitsPolicy: Every dimension is explicitly world pixels, source pixels, normalized coordinates, seconds, frames, FPS, Hz or PCM bits. Production atlas metadata contains measured per-frame attachments.

fonts.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1; preserve each downloaded license and version/hash.

reviewContract.alphaFringe: Inspect on paper, dark teal and checkerboard.
reviewContract.native: Inspect complete image and individual cells.
reviewContract.motion: Loop at target FPS at gameplay size, plus 2x.
reviewContract.scale: Survivor 56 world pixels; boss 150 world pixels. Distinguish hostile hazards from matte scenery.
reviewContract.regeneration: Regenerate materially inconsistent illustration or frames with image generation. Atlas slicing, padding and packing preserve source pixels and are recorded.
